integration.name: Fulcra Flow State v2 metadata provenance

license.boundary: The contribution was rebased onto the upstream revision carrying the repository-level MIT license. This records the published upstream license; it is not independent legal advice.

implementedCapabilities: Explicit opt-in is required before session or marker audio is read or hashed.
SHA-256 digests bind the session, marker and selected clip without embedding audio bytes or local paths.
The deterministic metadata record binds the marker boundary, extraction window, processing version, key and BPM estimates, and the MusicalIdea reference.
The optional sharing record omits full-session and marker digests and binds a hashed audience reference.
The implementation verifies canonical record integrity and refuses private sharing by default.

privateSessionValidation.boundary: PR #33 and its synthetic tests do not establish that the separately authorized private one-session validation was run. Any private result must remain outside this public artifact unless separately authorized for disclosure.
